value.services:
Business Divestiture

There comes a time in many business owners' lives when they seek to exit from their business. Reasons may include a desire to enter retirement/estate planning, a desire to pass on the enterprise to the right buyer to see future growth, one or more business owners, a desire to relocate, a desire to spend more time with family, etc. Regardless of the business owner's reason for selling our experience has taught us that selling a business is a complex endeavor. The experience can help the seller and buyer achieve their goals when handled professionally. Our team is deal-makers within all phases of the buying and selling process. We are comfortable and experienced in working with the myriad of advisors typically involved in a private business transfer. And importantly, we have a pulse on the market to help identify the most probable selling price based on a sophisticated business valuation process that leads to an opinion of value. If y desire to transfer your business to a new owner you can rely on us for a confidential and efficient business brokerage service that will allow you to achieve the best market price and terms for your business.   With our network of over a hundred offices that your business will have access to the broadest network of qualified business purchasers available in the marketplace today.

Buyer Representation Services

For some, purchasing an existing operating business with demonstrated success and cash flow is appealing. Prospective buyers rarely see the full range of opportunities available without the assistance of a professional advisor.

expertiseCategories.name: Education & Children
expertiseCategories.seoDescription: Education and child related businesses listed for sale on BizBuySell include a wide range of businesses focused on child development, learning, and family oriented services, including daycare and childcare centers, preschools, private K–12 schools, tutoring and test prep centers, learning franchises, kids’ activity and enrichment businesses, and child focused e commerce brands. The business models span tuition  and fee based services (licensed daycares, preschools, private schools, tutoring centers), franchise models with standardized curricula and brand support (learning centers, crafts, sports, and enrichment programs), and product or digital models such as Amazon FBA and direct to consumer e commerce brands selling children’s products or educational offerings.

expertiseCategories.name: Health Care & Fitness

value.companyOverview:
Greenland Advisors is a modern business brokerage firm based in Austin, Texas, focused on helping business owners exit with maximum value, discretion, and strategic precision.

We specialize in representing profitable, owner-operated and lower middle-market businesses across a range of industries, providing end-to-end advisory from valuation through closing. Our approach goes beyond traditional brokerage—we position each business like an asset, crafting compelling narratives, optimizing deal structure, and creating competitive buyer demand to drive premium outcomes.

Our process is built on three core principles:

Preparation drives valuation
Confidentiality protects value
Execution determines outcome

We work exclusively with serious owners who are ready to explore a sale within the next 6–24 months, as well as qualified buyers seeking vetted, high-quality opportunities in the Austin market.

At Greenland Advisors, we don’t just list businesses—we engineer successful exits.
value.introduction:
I work with business owners at one of the most important inflection points of their lives—when it’s time to sell what they’ve built.

With over $150 million in transaction experience, I bring a strategic, operator-minded approach to business brokerage that goes far beyond simply listing a business for sale. My background is rooted in understanding how businesses are built, scaled, and ultimately positioned for a successful exit—allowing me to advise owners not just on how to sell, but on how to maximize value before going to market.

I founded Greenland Advisors to bring a more modern, disciplined approach to the lower middle market in Austin. That means:

Treating each engagement like a structured transaction process—not a listing
Positioning businesses as premium assets through thoughtful preparation and narrative
Creating competitive buyer dynamics to drive stronger offers and better terms

My clients are typically profitable business owners who are serious about exploring a sale within the next 6–24 months and want a partner who can guide them through the process with clarity, discretion, and executional excellence.

I take pride in being hands-on throughout every stage—from valuation and positioning to negotiations and closing—ensuring nothing is left to chance.

If you’ve built something valuable, my role is to help you exit on your terms—and at a level that reflects what it’s truly worth.

value.services:
Greenland Advisors provides comprehensive, end-to-end advisory services designed to guide business owners through every stage of the sale process with precision and confidence. 

Our services begin with a detailed business valuation and exit readiness assessment, where we analyze financials, market positioning, and operational strengths to determine an accurate and defensible value. 

From there, we develop a customized go-to-market strategy, including the creation of professional marketing materials such as Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs), buyer summaries, and targeted outreach campaigns. 

We manage the entire buyer process—confidential marketing, screening and qualifying buyers, coordinating NDAs, and facilitating management calls—to ensure only serious, financially capable buyers are engaged. As offers are received, we lead negotiation and deal structuring to optimize price, terms, and risk mitigation, working closely with attorneys, CPAs, and lenders to keep the transaction on track. 

Throughout due diligence and closing, we act as the central quarterback, proactively addressing issues, maintaining momentum, and protecting confidentiality at every step. Whether an owner is preparing for an exit in the near term or planning ahead, our role is to maximize value, reduce friction, and deliver a smooth, successful transition

value.introduction:
Jeff Petersen was the President and Founder of Coal Creek Consulting, a firm that specializes in project management and infrastructure development for wireless telecommunication providers. During his years with Coal Creek, he grew the company to over twenty-five employees, and the company remains the gold standard in Arizona for wireless services. Jeff sold the company and attempted to retire in 2018.

Jeff now lives in East Texas.  He has a love of the outdoors that includes backpacking, hunting, hiking and winter sports. Jeff exhibits extreme dedication and perseverance through personal challenges such as running 14 half-marathons in one year, hiking rim-to-rim-to-rim across the Grand Canyon (47 miles) in one day, skiing across Finland (270 miles) in 7 days and riding a mountain bike from Durango, Colorado to Moab, Utah. Jeff is also a very mediocre guitar player and a terrible singer. 

Outside of his family, one of Jeff's most significant contributions is to Samaritan Aviation.  Samaritan Aviation is a Christian/Humanitarian organization that operates multiple Cessna 206 float planes in the East Sepic Province of Papua New Guinea.  Samaritan delivers supplies to aid posts across the region and provide life saving evacuation flights to the people of the area.  They then share the gospel with the patients as they care for them during their recovery in the only hospital for the entire province.  His involvement began when Samaritan Aviation rented office space from his company in Scottsdale, Arizona. In November of 2015, Jeff accompanied Founder and President Mark Palm on a two-week trip to Papua New Guinea. Jeff was moved by his visit and his interactions with the people of PNG as well as the Samaritan Aviation families serving in Papua New Guinea. Through his interaction with the Board, Jeff has assisted Samaritan Aviation with fundraising from major donors and strategic management consultation.

Jeff is also on the Board of Directors of Longview Ambucs and was awarded AMBUC of the year for 2020-2021.  He and the rest of the organization work hard to serve the local community through AMBUCS as they build ramps for those in need, provide trikes for disabled children and provide scholarships for local PT and OT students.

Jeff's involvement with Transworld Business Advisors began when he contracted them to assist in the sale of Coal Creek Consulting.  The transaction went so smoothly that he entered into an agreement to work with Transworld in the East Texas market.  Jeff is committed to "Good Deals for Good People".  As a member of the community, Jeff is committed to deals that are fair and equitable to all parties involved.  Contact him today.
